name: @jasakode/bip-0039
description: A native Go implementation of the Bitcoin BIP-0039 specification with full support for official wordlists, mnemonic generation, seed derivation, and validation against the official BIP-0039 test vectors.

scripts.build: GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -o dist/bip0039.wasm ./src && cp $(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js dist/

author: Jasakode
